**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or other employee-restraint covenant. Targeted searches across the full document for "solicit", "employ or engage employees", "employee", "employment", "personnel/staff", and "hire|recruit|induce" returned no hits, and the sole personnel-adjacent provision — Article 21 (Relationship of Parties, p0240) — merely disclaims partnership and limits the common enterprise to the express provisions of the Agreement.

Because our preferred position for NOSOLICIT is simply that Customer bears no non-solicitation restriction, the absence of any such covenant satisfies the preferred level. No redline proposed; nothing to narrow or delete.
